question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 7. **
solution:
The correct answer is: fine

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• "Able" means who has exceptional skill and has done well in the past.
 
• "Ripe" is used for fruit, grain, etc to mean that they are ready to be picked and eaten.
 
• "Sure" means having no doubt about something; certain.
 
• "Fine" means very good in quality or appearance.
 
 
 
• *​*As per the meaning of the given words "Fine"* *is the appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• When we refer to someone as **"a fine swimmer" **or **"a fine teacher"**, it is used as an **adjective.**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 4.
